label: Absence-world grounding of the actual world from Aristotelian modality at every world
meaning: Instantiation (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): Aristotelian modality at every world, instantiated at each absence world v and the proposition that w obtains, gives the grounding premise of Pruss's own direction (607e94cf), on the same frame, power primitive, concreteness predicate and world. The converse fails (the controls' separator). As a transcription it closes 607e94cf only if the universal principle is closed, and it never expands it in the route-cost diagnostic.
